nodes.label: Privacy-Safe Bug Fixture
nodes.rationale: Public-domain or synthetic fixtures and removal of book text, file paths, and private content prevent reports from exposing copyrighted or personal material.

nodes.label: Pull Request Verification Checklist
nodes.rationale: Formatting, tests, a universal Release build, and app verification provide evidence that a change is ready.

nodes.label: Offline and Privacy Guardrail
nodes.rationale: Core reading and narration must continue without networking, analytics, uploads, or an outgoing-network entitlement.

nodes.label: Universal Release Verification
nodes.rationale: CI builds both arm64 and x86_64 slices and inspects the app so architecture and packaging regressions are caught.

nodes.label: Tag and Marketing Version Validation
nodes.rationale: The v-prefixed tag must match the Xcode target marketing version before publishing.

nodes.label: Versioned Release Artifacts and Checksums
nodes.rationale: The release bundles the universal app, license notices, and SHA-256 checksums so users can validate what they download.

nodes.label: Harassment-Free Participation
nodes.rationale: Participation should be safe and inclusive for people across identities, backgrounds, and experience levels.

nodes.label: Focused Failing Test First
nodes.rationale: Behavior changes should begin with a focused failing test.

nodes.label: Local-Only Core Flows
nodes.rationale: Analytics, uploads, cloud accounts, and network requirements must not enter core reading or narration.

nodes.label: Accessible UI Verification
nodes.rationale: UI contributions must cite Apple guidance and verify keyboard, VoiceOver, appearance, and reduced-motion behavior.

nodes.label: Local-First EPUB and PDF Listener
nodes.rationale: Books are indexed and narrated on the user's Mac so listening does not require cloud document or speech services.

nodes.label: First-450-Word Playback
nodes.rationale: Narration can begin after the first 450 indexed words while the remainder of the book is prepared.

nodes.label: No Production Networking or Analytics
nodes.rationale: Core privacy is preserved by keeping documents and speech local; only limited playback metadata reaches macOS Now Playing during active playback.

nodes.label: Public Release Artifact
nodes.rationale: Public downloads must be universal, Developer ID signed, hardened, notarized, and stapled.

nodes.label: Sandbox and No-Network Entitlement Boundary
nodes.rationale: The app uses app-scoped bookmarks and user-selected file access without an outgoing-network entitlement.

nodes.label: Repository Secret Storage Policy
nodes.rationale: Signing and notarization credentials must never be stored in the repository.

nodes.label: Browsing-Independent Persistent Player
nodes.rationale: Browsing collection and detail routes must not change narration; only explicit listening or chapter actions may do so.

nodes.label: System Glass with One Player Container
nodes.rationale: Native surfaces supply most glass, while one GlassEffectContainer keeps player metadata, transport, and progress visually coherent.
nodes.norm_label: system glass with one player container

nodes.label: Accessible Semantic UI
nodes.rationale: Semantic styles, system selection, symbols plus text, and accessibility values keep state understandable without color alone.

nodes.label: Playback and Zen Session Continuity
nodes.rationale: Browsing, cross-window chapter selection, and closing Zen preserve or deliberately switch the one shared playback session.
